OUR PUPS MAKE THE
PERFECT COMPANION

At Plush Pups by Reeds, we specialize in small and toy-sized companions known for their charm, adaptability, and affectionate personalities. While our inventory may change, many of our plush pups share the following qualities that make them perfect additions to any home:

WHY PLUSH PUPS IS FOR YOU!

Great for Apartment Living

Our pups tend to be on the smaller side, making them ideal for cozy spaces and city living without sacrificing personality.

Family-Friendly

These pups are gentle, loving, and easy to bond with — perfect for families with children or first-time pet parents.

Low to Moderate Shedding

Many of the puppies we place are loved for their manageable coats, making them a great choice for families looking for low-maintenance grooming.

Loyal Lap Dogs

Whether you're working from home or relaxing on the weekends, our pups thrive on companionship and love to snuggle.

Social & Easy to Train

Raised in nurturing, hands-on environments, our plush pups come ready to learn, play, and love.

Adaptable & Travel-Ready

Whether you're staying local or frequently on the move, these pups adjust well to new environments and travel — especially with our flight nanny service available across the U.S.

ABOUT US

MEET THE PUPPY PROVIDERS

At Plush Pups By Reeds, we specialize in raising well-adjusted, healthy puppies that grow into happy, confident companions. With over 15 years of experience in various breeds our commitment to quality and care is reflected in every pup we place. We focus on early socialization, exceptional health standards, and nurturing each puppy’s unique personality and charm. Whether you’re a first-time dog owner or adding to a growing pack, our goal is to help you find the perfect addition to your family.
